_source: rsprox 232/03162 and 232/03165 (Drew, the grinder) and the Wiki (Drew: 25,000 buckets, 50 coins a bucket of sand; Sandstorm: 25,000 sand). Chathead animations are the recorded ones.
_maxSand: Wiki (Sandstorm; the release notes): the grinder holds 25,000 buckets of sand.
_sandstone: Buckets of sand each piece grinds into (recorded: 1kg 1, 2kg 2, 5kg 4, 10kg 8; every grind fits).

messages.greeting: Hey there, what can I do for ya?
messages.nothing: Nothing sorry. I have to be going now.
about: My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
I can also look after any buckets ya want me to.
Me and Sandstorm go way back, we started off back in the desert mining camp, I was a slave and I had the honour of looking after Sandstorm.
How did you and Sandstorm get out of the mining camp?
Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.

While the guards weren't looking, I would take apart Sandstorm piece by piece and place the pieces in boxes and barrels, when Sandstorms inners were all gutted, I tricked the cart driver by telling him cart jokes.
So, he didn't bother to check his cargo and I was able to board as he was driving off.
Anyway, that's all in the past. Can I help ya with anything else?
messages.depositPrompt: How many buckets do you wish to deposit?
messages.noBuckets: You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
messages.full: I can't hold any more buckets for you.
messages.holdingOne: I am only holding onto one bucket for ya.
messages.holding: I am holding onto {buckets} buckets for ya.
messages.holdingMany: I am holding onto {buckets} buckets for ya. Why would ya want so many buckets?
messages.check: I have {buckets} of your buckets and you've ground enough sandstone for {sand} buckets of sand.
messages.purchase: Would ya like to purchase some buckets of sand?
messages.nothingToClaim: Ya don't have any buckets of sand to withdraw. Ya need to give me empty buckets, and grind sandstone in my grinder, then I'll sell ya buckets of sand.
messages.poor: Ya do not have enough money to withdraw even one bucket of sand; I charge 50 coins per bucket. Come back to me when ya have more money.
messages.claimPrompt: How many buckets of sand do ya want? (50 coins each)
messages.zeroSand: Come back when ya actually want some buckets of sand.
messages.claimed: If ya need any more sand, please come back and use Sandstorm again.
messages.noRoom: Ya don't have room in your pack for the sand.
messages.ground: The grinder is holding enough sandstone for {sand} buckets of sand.
messages.noSandstone: You do not have any sandstone to grind.
messages.noted: Sorry mate, ya can't turn noted sandstone into sand. Come back with some real sandstone.
